# Getting Started

## Install and launching R packages

The code chunk below uses [p_load()](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/pacman/index.html) of pacman packages to check if tidyverse pacakges are installed in the computer. If they are, then they will be lunched into R.

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse)
```

## Importing the data

```{r}
exam_data <- read_csv("data/Exam_data.csv")
```

## Plotting a simple bar chart

```{r}
ggplot(data = exam_data,
       aes(x = RACE)) + 
  geom_bar()
```

##ggplot

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x= MATHS))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x= MATHS))
```

##geom_bar

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x=RACE)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
exam_data$MATHS <- as.numeric(exam_data$MATHS)

```

```{r}
exam_data$ENGLISH <- as.numeric(exam_data$ENGLISH)

```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  geom_dotplot(dotsize = 0.5)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  geom_dotplot(binwidth=2.5,         
               dotsize = 0.5) +      
  scale_y_continuous(NULL,           
                     breaks = NULL)  
```

##geom_histogram()

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x = MATHS)) +
  geom_histogram()       
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x= MATHS)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=20,            
                 color="black",      
                 fill="light blue")  
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x= MATHS, 
           fill = GENDER)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=20, 
                 color="grey30")
```

```{r}

```

```{r}

```



```{r}

```

```{r}

```

```{r}
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(y = MATHS, x= GENDER)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_summary(geom = "point",       
               fun = "mean",         
               colour ="red",        
               size=4)               
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(y = MATHS, x= GENDER)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(stat="summary",        
             fun="mean",           
             colour="red",          
             size=4)          
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x= MATHS, y=ENGLISH)) +

```

```{r}

       aes(x= MATHS,
```


```{r}

       aes(x= MATHS)) +
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x=RACE)) +
  geom_bar()
```


```{r}

       aes(x= MATHS, y=ENGLISH)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method=lm, size=0.5)
```

```{r}

       aes(x= MATHS, y=ENGLISH)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method=lm,

                  ylim=c(0,100))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=exam_data, 
       aes(x=RACE)) +
```


